ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform dark pigmentation with specific high-contrast white focal points at the lower center (peduncle attachment) and along the trailing edge tips. Three distinct circular low-contrast 'ghost' markings (grey on black) are visible on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 105 degrees and a depth of approximately 12% relative to the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency of peaks is higher on the inner lobes, with several larger, jagged 'valleys' or notches located on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the trailing edge tips of both lobes and a small cluster at the base of the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of thin, light-grey diagonal linear marks (rake-like features) are visible on the mid-right lobe surface; a single short horizontal white scratch is visible on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable circular depigmentation patterns or lesions on the right lobe; white scarring/calcification concentrated at the trailing edge extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique set of concentric circular patterns on the right lobe surface, differing in texture and intensity from the surrounding dark pigmentation.
